lazytntutils.config.title: Lazy TNT Utils
lazytntutils.config.option.clientSync.de: The client no longer simulates entity movement locally; in singleplayer it reads from the integrated server.
lazytntutils.config.option.serverSync.de: In multiplayer, the server sends the true entity state to the client every tick.
lazytntutils.config.option.tickTimer.des: Show a label with the ticks left above the TNT.
Disable the white flashing when it is lit and the growing animation before it explodes.
lazytntutils.config.option.arrow.desc.1: Draw a momentum arrow when hitboxes are shown with F3+B.
lazytntutils.config.option.explosionPart: Render a single explosion particle exactly at the blast position.
lazytntutils.config.option.facingArrow.d: The entity facing arrow that vanilla draws when hitboxes are shown with F3+B.
lazytntutils.config.option.distance.desc: Override this distance on the server; applies to the current session only.
